content.value_statement: Writing Turkish petitions and official letters requires formal wording, clear structure, and the right recipient details. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to produce polished Turkish drafts from user facts.
actual_capabilities: Drafts general Turkish petitions with recipient, subject, request, signature, and attachment sections.
Provides templates for SGK service document requests and tax objection letters.
Creates resignation notices, tenant eviction notices, and job application letters.
Prompts for recipient, request, applicant identity, reasons, and attachments before drafting.
Warns users about TC identity number privacy and recommends legal review for legal processes.
limitations: Does not verify current laws, forms, deadlines, or institution-specific rules.
Does not replace a lawyer, tax adviser, or public authority guidance.
Requires user-supplied facts; it does not fetch records or submit documents.
May include sensitive personal data only when the user provides it and accepts the privacy risk.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Public Petition
use_cases.description: Create a formal Turkish petition for a municipality, ministry, school, or public office.

use_cases.title: Respond to Administrative Decisions
use_cases.description: Draft an objection letter for SGK, tax office, or similar administrative correspondence.

use_cases.title: Create Workplace Correspondence
use_cases.description: Write resignation notices, job application letters, or structured HR correspondence in formal Turkish.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Petition
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Turkish petition for [institution]. My request is [request]. Ask me for any missing required details before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Draft an SGK Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a formal SGK service document request. Use these details: name, TC placeholder, SGK number, work dates, city, and attachments.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Objection Letter
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Turkish objection letter for [decision]. Include a clear subject, receipt date, reasons, requested correction, and attachment list.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Complete Formal Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete Turkish formal letter package for [situation]. Include the main draft, missing information questions, attachment checklist, and privacy warnings.

output_examples.input: User asks for a municipality petition about a street repair request.
output_examples.output: A formal Turkish petition with city, date, municipal address, concise subject, request paragraph, signature block, and attachment list.

output_examples.input: User needs an SGK service document request letter.
output_examples.output: A respectful SGK letter that includes identity placeholders, employment dates, the requested document, contact details, and required attachments.

output_examples.input: User wants to resign from a company with notice period wording.
output_examples.output: A formal resignation notice with department details, effective date, notice period statement, handover commitment, and signature section.

best_practices: Provide the exact institution name, city, subject, request, dates, and attachment list.
Replace placeholders with accurate facts only after reviewing privacy risks.
Ask a lawyer or responsible authority to review documents with legal effects.
anti_patterns: Do not enter a real TC identity number unless it is required and safe to share.
Do not ask the model to invent legal bases, case facts, or official decisions.
Do not submit a draft without checking deadlines, required forms, and local procedures.

faq.question: Can this skill write Turkish petitions?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides formal Turkish petition structure, wording, signature sections, and attachment lists.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can it replace legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It can draft documents, but legal processes should be reviewed by a lawyer or responsible authority.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the recipient institution, request, reasons, dates, identity placeholders, contact details, and attachments.

faq.question: Does it submit documents for me?
faq.answer: No. It only drafts text. You must submit the final document through the correct official channel.

faq.question: How should I handle personal data?
faq.answer: Use placeholders for sensitive data until the final review. Add real identifiers only when necessary.
